Coram:
 Hon'ble Mr Justice Badar Durrez Ahmed, Chief Justice  Hon'ble Mr Justice Alok Aradhe, Judge

Appearance:
For petitioner(s): Mr B. A. Bashir, Sr. Advocate, amicus curiae with Ms Farah Bashir,
 Advocate For respondent(s): Mr M. I. Dar, AAG Mr Syed Manzoor, Advocate i/ Whether to be reported in Yes/No Press/Media?
ii/ Whether to be reported in Yes/No  Digest/Journal?
1.
The creation of the post of Commissioner of Food Safety has still not been completed.

As per the status report presented on 04.10.2017 on behalf of the State of J&K through the Principal Secretary to the Government, Health & Medical Education Department, it is evident that the proposal submitted to the Finance Department for creation of the post has been cleared by the said department.

However, in the said report, it is submitted that the proposal was for the creation of the post of Commissioner of Food Safety along-with supportive staff, but the Finance Department has only cleared the proposal for creation of the post of Commissioner of Food Safety and not of the supportive staff.
2. We fail to understand how the Government is functioning.
When the proposal was for the post of Commissioner of Food Safety along-with supportive staff, the entire proposal ought to have been cleared.
This is not merely as per the directions given by the Court, but it is the mandate of the Act Initiating Suo Moto Action vs State Of Jk & Ors.

that there must be a Commissioner of Food Safety.
The Finance Department is directed to clear the proposal within a week.
Thereafter, the same be placed before the Cabinet for final approval.

We hope that this process would be completed at the earliest and that the process of selecting the persons to fill the post of Commissioner of Food Safety along-with the supportive staff is also completed at an early date and not later than six weeks from today.

3. With regard to 16 Food Safety Officers, we are informed that the Service Selection Board by the letter dated 25.09.2017, has recommended the select list of 16 Food Safety Officers and one Assistant Public Analyst.
The same was received by the concerned department on 28.09.2017 and the appointment orders are likely to be issued shortly.
We direct that the same be issued within two weeks from today.
4. The status report also indicates that in compliance of the directions given by this Court, the department has applied for NABL Accreditation.
The said application has been sent to the National Accreditation Board for Testing of Calibration Laboratories for both Jammu as well as for Kashmir Laboratories.

entities.text: National Accreditation Board for Testing of Calibration Laboratories
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applications have been acknowledged vide communication dated 31.08.2017 and 06.09.2017 respectively.

It was further submitted that with regard to achieve the said accreditation,
two Food Analysts, one from Srinagar and one from Jammu were deputed to the National Institute of Training for Standardization Bureau of Indian Standards for undergoing the necessary training.

entities.text: National Institute of Training for Standardization Bureau of Indian Standards
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 5. On the previous occasion itself, it had been recorded that the kitchen has been shifted from the building where the Forensic Science Laboratory, Srinagar is functioning.
The kitchen was being run by the police authorities who have since closed the kitchen, however, the space is yet to be vacated by them.
This was recorded on the previous occasion.
Further progress in the matter was to be reported.
Unfortunately, the said report has been submitted on 04.10.2017, but no progress has been indicated.
The next status report shall clearly indicate what steps have been taken to have the entire premises within the control of the Forensic Science Laboratory.
Annexures 6 and 7 to the status report indicate the status of installation along-with the functions performed by the equipments at Jammu and Srinagar.

6. The directions given by us with regard to checking the labels of the packaged food products and to verify as to whether the labels are in accordance with the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the regulations made thereunder are being complied with as per the status report.

The communication dated 26.09.2017 issued by the Deputy Commissioner, Food Safety, Kashmir to the Controller, Drug and Food Controller Organization, J&K, Srinagar indicates that a special drive has been undertaken to implement the provisions in this regard.

entities.text: Controller, Drug and Food Controller Organization, J&K, Srinagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: A similar communication has been addressed in respect of Jammu also.

The annexures to the said communication also indicate that the various samples were lifted and a number of them were found to be in contravention of the Act and the Regulations and obviously action under the said provisions are being taken.
The drive be continued.
7. We are also informed by Mr M. I. Dar, learned AAG that the State of JK now has 7 mobile labs.
Three are for the Kashmir Valley, three for Jammu and one for Leh.
The report be submitted with regard to the functioning of these mobile lab vans before the next date of hearing.
